lines.style: Speak as a nervous Japanese beginner on the first day at a new job, bowing to a new colleague and not knowing the English. Say 'Please...' slowly and hesitantly in katakana-like English, trail off, a short pause, then say the Japanese word 'yoroshiku' with Japanese pronunciation (yo-ro-shi-ku) and a small unsure rising intonation, as if asking. Natural, not a caricature.

lines.text: I look forward to working with you.
